description.zh: 任务结果回调URL，目前仅支持HTTP地址。
description.en: The URL for receiving callback notifications. Currently, only HTTP URLs are supported.

description.zh:
溯源水印ab流处理视频输入OSS地址。OSS的地域需要与当前MPS所在地域保持一致。


> 提交视频溯源水印ab流作业目前仅支持3分钟及以上视频，视频时间过短会导致接口调用失败或无输出。
description.en:
The Object Storage Service (OSS) location of the input video. The region of the OSS bucket must be the same as the region where you use Media Processing Service (MPS).

>

description.zh: 水印级别，取值0/1/2，表示嵌入通道，0u，1uv，2yuv。
description.en: The watermark level. This parameter specifies the color channels for embedding the watermark. Valid values: 0 (U channel), 1 (UV channels), and 2 (YUV channels).

description.zh: 溯源水印ab流处理输出OSS地址。需要注意的是，配置的是输出目录Dir。
description.en: The Object Storage Service (OSS) location for the job output. You must specify the output directory by using the `Dir` parameter.

description.zh: 水印嵌入开始时间。单位：秒。
description.en: The start time for embedding the watermark, in seconds.

description.zh: 水印嵌入总时间。单位：秒。
description.en: The total duration for embedding the watermark, in seconds.

description.zh: 可公网访问的视频URL链接。填写后优先将其作为任务输入，其次再考虑Input输入。
description.en: A publicly accessible URL of the video. This URL overrides the `Input` parameter.

description.zh: 用户自定义数据，最大长度1024个字节。
description.en: The custom user data. The maximum length is 1,024 bytes.

title.zh: 提交视频溯源水印ab流作业
title.en: Submit Video Tracing Watermark AB Stream Job

descriptions.zh:
- 提交视频溯源水印ab流作业目前仅支持3分钟及以上视频，视频时间过短会导致接口调用失败或无输出。

- 目前数字水印相关接口只支持华东2（上海）、华北2（北京）地域使用。

- 该接口为[异步接口](~~3027615~~)，提交任务后返回任务ID（此时任务尚未完成，任务将进入后台排队异步执行），最终结果将通过回调通知，也可通过[查询视频溯源水印ab流作业](~~2834788~~)主动查询任务状态。
descriptions.en:
- You can submit a video tracing watermark A/B stream job only for videos that are 3 minutes or longer. Processing shorter videos may cause the operation to fail or produce no output.

- Digital watermark-related operations are currently available only in the China (Shanghai) and China (Beijing) regions.

- This is an [asynchronous operation](~~3027615~~). After submission, the system returns a job ID and processes the job in the background. A callback notification delivers the final result. You can also call the [QueryTraceAbJob](~~2834788~~) operation to query the job status.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mts submit-trace-ab-job --input Bucket_:_ivison-test_,_Location_:_oss-cn-shanghai_,_Object_:_test.mp4 --biz-output Bucket_:_ivison-test_,_Location_:_oss-cn-shanghai_,_Dir_:_out/ --start-time 0 --total-time 360 --level 2 --call-back http://example.com/callback --url http://www.example.com/video/test.mp4 --user-data 123 --cipher-base64-ed Qh6OdgIMcliQSI1fReOw0000 --api-version 2014-06-18 --region cn-hangzhou
